preconditions.description: n and k are positive integers with k less than n

postconditions.description: The permutation has exactly n elements
All elements in the permutation are distinct

postconditions.expression: len(set(abs(p[i] - p[i+1]) for i in range(n-1))) == k
postconditions.description: The group of numbers |p_1 - p_2|, |p_2 - p_3|, ..., |p_{n} - p_{n-1}| has exactly k distinct elements
